gaps.title: Git Working Tree Dirty & Untracked Baseline
gaps.description: Over 190 canonical files (specs, tests, engines) are untracked in Git, breaking clean-room remote clone reproducibility.
gaps.impact: Remote developers or CI cannot reproduce test results.
gaps.recommended_action: Stage and commit all canonical files to Git baseline.

gaps.title: State Machine Duality & Desynchronization
gaps.description: MissionRuntime (8-state SDD in .missions/) and EOSMissionOrchestrator (7-temple Octaves in-memory) operate independently with zero state sharing.
gaps.evidence: mcp-server.js routes eos.mission.* to MissionRuntime and eos.orchestrator.* to EOSMissionOrchestrator.
gaps.impact: Operator confusion and disjointed mission lifecycles.
gaps.recommended_action: Unify the two engines into one canonical state machine backed by .missions/ storage.

gaps.title: Orchestrator In-Memory State Volatility
gaps.description: EOSMissionOrchestrator.activeMissions uses an in-memory Map() that is lost upon process restart.
gaps.impact: Any crash or server restart destroys in-flight mission state.
gaps.recommended_action: Hydrate and persist orchestrator state to EOSKabbalahLedger or .missions/ disk files.

gaps.title: Speculative Architecture & Memory Overhead
gaps.description: MissionRuntime instantiates 40+ simulation engines (Raft, Bytecode VM, LSM Tree) on every constructor call.
gaps.impact: Heap bloat and unnecessary cognitive complexity.

gaps.title: Write Barrier Limited to MCP Layer
gaps.description: External write barrier is checked when calling MCP tools, but raw Node fs calls in scripts bypass it.
gaps.evidence: fs.writeFileSync calls in standalone scripts bypass barrier_check.
gaps.impact: Direct script execution could accidentally touch protected files if not guarded by IDE sandbox.
gaps.recommended_action: Enforce filesystem proxy or process-level cwd bounding.
